measures.title: Local Sales Tax for Schools
measures.summary: Asks whether Stafford County may levy a local retail sales tax of up to one percent (1%), with the revenue usable only to build new schools or for major renovation of schools serving Stafford County. The tax would end when any bonds or loans issued for the projects are repaid, or, if the projects are not funded by bonds or loans, on June 30, 2046. The county says approval would authorize the tax but would not levy it immediately; a public hearing and an ordinance would still be required.
measures.yesMeans: Stafford County is authorized to levy a local sales tax of up to 1% for new school construction and major school renovations.
measures.noMeans: Stafford County is not authorized to levy this school sales tax.
